design_principle: A circular sundial chart · the rim shows the twelve double-hours, the inner ring the demon's daily time allocation · each demon's schedule differs
core_insight: Reads villain strategy through 'time budgets', revealing the 'involution' of low-ranking demons and the 'sense of ease' of well-connected demons
